en.title: Energy Market Analysis
en.summary: Market value evaluation for wind and solar across electricity markets.
en.challenge: Wind and solar generation have different market value because production profiles interact with time-varying electricity prices, not just annual energy totals.
contribution: Prepared generation and electricity-price time series for consistent market-value comparison.
Implemented capture-price and value-factor calculations for wind and solar scenarios.
Created plots and documentation that explain the relationship between timing and revenue.
technical: Pandas aligns hourly or interval generation with market-price data.
Python calculates weighted capture prices, value factors, and scenario comparisons.
Visualizations communicate temporal patterns and differences between technologies.

architecture.label: Inputs
architecture.detail: Renewable generation profiles and electricity market prices provide aligned time series.

architecture.label: Preparation
architecture.detail: Python cleans timestamps, gaps, units, and comparable periods.

architecture.label: Valuation
architecture.detail: Capture price and value-factor calculations quantify market value.

architecture.label: Interpretation
architecture.detail: Plots and scenarios explain why technology value differs by timing and market.

outcomes: Translated energy-market theory into a reproducible analytical workflow.
Demonstrated time-series preparation, quantitative modeling, and clear visualization.
Published the analysis as a public Python repository.

zh.title: 能源市場分析
zh.summary: 分析風能與太陽能在各電力市場的價值。
zh.challenge: 風能與太陽能的市場價值不只取決於年度發電量，也受到發電曲線與隨時間變動之電價互動的影響。
contribution: 整理發電與電價時間序列，建立一致的市場價值比較基礎。
實作風能與太陽能情境的捕獲價格與價值因子計算。
製作圖表與文件，說明發電時間與收益之間的關係。
technical: Pandas 將每小時或各時段的發電量與市場電價對齊。
Python 計算加權捕獲價格、價值因子與不同情境的比較結果。
視覺化呈現時間模式與不同發電技術之間的差異。

architecture.label: 輸入
architecture.detail: 再生能源發電曲線與電力市場價格構成對齊後的時間序列。

architecture.label: 資料準備
architecture.detail: Python 清理時間戳記、缺值、單位與可比較期間。

architecture.label: 價值評估
architecture.detail: 透過捕獲價格與價值因子量化市場價值。

architecture.label: 結果解讀
architecture.detail: 圖表與情境分析說明不同技術為何會因時間與市場而產生價值差異。

outcomes: 將能源市場理論轉換為可重現的分析流程。
展現時間序列整理、量化建模與清楚視覺化能力。
以公開 Python 儲存庫發布分析成果。
